import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from lib import *
P,y,ids,X = load_data(practice, tokenize, LABELS)
V=30522; N=len(P)
n=np.array([len(t) for t in ids]); Xtf=sp.diags(1.0/n)@X
def nb(tr,alpha=0.3):
    cnt=np.zeros((V,8))
    for c in range(8): cnt[:,c]=np.asarray(X[tr][y[tr]==c].sum(0)).ravel()
    lp=np.log(cnt+alpha)-np.log(cnt.sum(0)+alpha*V); return lp-lp.mean(1,keepdims=True)
def ridge(tr,Xf,lam):
    Xc=Xf[tr]; Yc=np.eye(8)[y[tr]]
    Kk=(Xc@Xc.T).toarray(); A=np.linalg.solve(Kk+lam*np.eye(len(tr)), Yc-Yc.mean(0))
    S=np.asarray(Xc.T@A); return S-S.mean(1,keepdims=True)
res={}
allpred=[]
for seed in [0,1,2]:
    rng=np.random.RandomState(seed); perm=rng.permutation(N); folds=np.array_split(perm,5)
    pred=np.zeros(N,int); pred0=np.zeros(N,int)
    for f in folds:
        tr=np.setdiff1d(np.arange(N),f)
        S=nb(tr)/4+ridge(tr,Xtf,3e-3)
        pred[f]=(X[f]@S).argmax(1)
        S0=S.copy(); S0[[0,101,102]]=0
        pred0[f]=(X[f]@S0).argmax(1)
    res.setdefault('with cls/sep',[]).append((pred==y).mean()); res.setdefault('zeroed',[]).append((pred0==y).mean())
    allpred.append(pred0)
for k,v in res.items(): print(k, np.round(v,4), np.mean(v))
cm=np.zeros((8,8),int)
for a_,b_ in zip(np.tile(y,3),np.concatenate(allpred)): cm[a_,b_]+=1
print(cm)
f1=[2*cm[c,c]/(cm[c].sum()+cm[:,c].sum()) for c in range(8)]; print('per-class F1', np.round(f1,3))
